ref_text: Here's how this walkthrough works. Each step lights up part of the board while I explain it, so you can follow along with the drawing. When a step ends, the next one starts on its own, and you can pause, go back, or jump to any step at any time.
origin: Made with Qwen3-TTS 1.7B (Apache 2.0): a narrator designed from the description 'a warm, friendly, calm male narrator in his forties with a relaxed American accent; unhurried, clear and conversational', then cloned with the Base model reading this paragraph. Synthetic; not a recording of a real person.
